description: This file defines a React component for the navigation header of an e-commerce website, including search, menu toggles, user account options, and cart interactions.

classes.name: Navigation
classes.description: A React component implementing the website's navigation bar with search, user menu, brand dropdown, and cart.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches store brands and categories when the component mounts.

methods.name: toggleBrand
methods.description: Fetches store brands and toggles the brand dropdown menu.

methods.name: toggleMenu
methods.description: Fetches store categories and toggles the main menu.

methods.name: getSuggestionValue
methods.description: Returns the name of a suggestion for the autosuggest component.

methods.name: renderSuggestion
methods.description: Renders a suggestion item in the autosuggest dropdown, highlighting matched text.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire navigation header including logo, search bar, user options, and cart.
